title: Fuzi decoction ameliorates intervertebral disc degeneration through ferroptosis modulation by suppressing NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Liu, Xiaodong; Pan, Feng; Sha, Chunhe; Wang, Zhiqing; Liu, Guohui; Wang, Hua; Ling, Shiyong; Huang, Kai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药附子汤通过NF-kappaB通路调节铁死亡治疗椎间盘退变，仅涉及分子对接验证药物-靶点结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Intervertebral disc degeneration (IVDD) is a complex condition that necessitates the development of novel therapeutic strategies. The objective of this study was to investigate the therapeutic potential of Fuzi decoction (FZD) in the treatment of IVDD by examining its bioactive components, target genes, molecular interactions, pathways, and therapeutic efficacy. METHODS: Bioactive ingredients with an oral bioavailability (OB) of >/= 30 % and drug likeness (DL) of >/= 0.18 were identified using the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology (TCMSP) database. Target genes associated with IVDD were retrieved from various databases, and a Venn diagram was employed to determine the common targets between IVDD and FZD. Subsequent network analyses, including ingredient-target-disease networks and protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks, were constructed. Functional enrichment analyses, such as Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), were conducted to delineate the biological processes, pathways, and potential mechanisms. Molecular docking was utilized to validate the interactions between FZD ingredients and target genes. In vitro assays using nucleus pulposus cells (NPCs) evaluated the effects of FZD-containing serum (FCS) on extracellular matrix (ECM) degradation, ferroptosis, and NF-kappaB pathway modulation. Additionally, rat models were used to confirm the therapeutic effects of FZD on IVDD. RESULTS: FZD was found to contain 77 bioactive ingredients and 108 related targets, with 101 common targets identified between IVDD and FZD. Network analyses pinpointed key ingredients and targets, with a particular focus on PTGS2 and IL1B as central to IVDD. Enrichment analyses revealed pathways related to reactive oxygen species and NF-kappaB signaling. Molecular docking confirmed robust interactions between core ingredients and target proteins. Pharmacological findings were substantiated by in vitro and in vivo experiments, demonstrating that FCS alleviated IL-1beta-induced ECM degradation and ferroptosis by inhibiting the NF-kappaB pathway in NPCs. CONCLUSIONS: FZD demonstrates efficacy in alleviating IVDD by regulating ECM degradation and ferroptosis through the suppression of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. These findings suggest that FZD may be a promising therapeutic agent for the treatment of IVDD, offering insights into its multifaceted mechanisms and molecular interactions for potential clinical application.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：椎间盘退变（IVDD）是一种复杂疾病，亟需开发新型治疗策略。本研究旨在通过考察附子汤（FZD）的生物活性成分、靶基因、分子相互作用、通路及治疗效果，探讨其在治疗IVDD中的潜在作用。方法：利用中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台（TCMSP）筛选出口服生物利用度（OB）≥30%且类药性（DL）≥0.18的生物活性成分。从多个数据库获取与IVDD相关的靶基因，并采用韦恩图确定IVDD与FZD之间的共同靶点。随后构建网络分析，包括成分-靶点-疾病网络和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。进行功能富集分析，如基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG），以阐明生物学过程、通路及潜在机制。利用分子对接验证FZD成分与靶基因之间的相互作用。使用髓核细胞（NPCs）的体外实验评估含FZD血清（FCS）对细胞外基质（ECM）降解、铁死亡及NF-κB通路调节的影响。此外，采用大鼠模型确认FZD对IVDD的治疗效果。结果：发现FZD含有77种生物活性成分和108个相关靶点，其中IVDD与FZD之间鉴定出101个共同靶点。网络分析确定了关键成分和靶点，特别关注PTGS2和IL1B作为IVDD的核心。富集分析揭示了与活性氧和NF-κB信号相关的通路。分子对接证实了核心成分与靶蛋白之间的强相互作用。药理学发现通过体外和体内实验得到验证，表明FCS通过抑制NPCs中的NF-κB通路，减轻了IL-1β诱导的ECM降解和铁死亡。结论：FZD通过抑制NF-κB信号通路调节ECM降解和铁死亡，从而有效缓解IVDD。这些发现表明，FZD可能成为治疗IVDD的有前景的治疗药物，为其多层面机制和分子相互作用提供见解，以支持潜在的临床应用。
